entry_gate: prioritized discovery pair with completed pair-level novelty audit; Tier B claims additionally require independent replication or prespecified strong local support

local_analysis.warning: global rg does not establish local sharing

pleiotropy.warning: directional genetic evidence is not automatically causal

fine_mapping_colocalization.warning: colocalization supports a shared signal model but does not prove a causal gene or pathway

mechanistic_annotation.required_language: rank evidence and preserve uncertainty; do not promote annotation into causal proof
